Click!

Five seconds...

Click!

Those at the bottom of the hierarchy are the most crucial. It is the working people who sow the fields and run the factories. They are the ones who harvest the material crucial for all survival. Without the flow of material, there can be no life.

We, by means left obscure, were made to fill that niche. This has only barely kept the beast alive; and the toll of its death-bell draws near.

To go digging, and to find awesome and terrible things below the ground. Did we ever wonder if those things were buried for a reason?

I've seen what shapeless things wriggle and crawl in the gaps between collective minds and the material world. We know that humanity was murdered, not by its own hand but by a foreign malefactor. A malignance masquerading as human.

Ultimately, those at the very top of the social-economic hierarchy are still slaves to the machine that put them there. Any political or economic power they possess can only be used to sustain the system they were born into. From top to bottom, we are all servants of the beast.
